changes.before: Makes Claude tmux-aware. A SessionStart hook detects when Claude runs inside tmux and surfaces the panes the user is watching, plus a skill for reading and driving interactive/long-running CLIs (Node REPL, dev servers, test watchers, the node debugger) by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output.
changes.after: Makes DipoleML tmux-aware. A SessionStart hook detects when DipoleML runs inside tmux and surfaces the panes the user is watching, plus a skill for reading and driving interactive/long-running CLIs (Node REPL, dev servers, test watchers, the node debugger) by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output.
